properties.name: The read cache moves to lru 0.19, with no code change and no change a store or an older seat can see
properties.rationale: Under req:reflow2-keeps-its-dependencies-at-or-near-their-latest-releases a new 0.x series gets its own change; on Anthony's word 2026-10-18 ("Bump on the cut branch") it is its own commit inside the v0.87.0 cut (PR #769), as Tantivy 0.27 was inside v0.86.0's, because only one design PR can hold reflow2's design at a time. MEASURED: cargo test -p reflow2-core with and without RocksDB, 2,170 passed and 0 failed (the cache's 8 unit tests included); dependency_currency.py after the bump: OK. Read in lru's CHANGELOG, 0.18.5 -> 0.19.0: only the iterator Sync bound. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: lru 0.18 -> 0.19 (the new 0.x series published 2026-10-18, which turned the v0.87.0 cut's dependency-currency check red). 0.19.0's one change is "Require `Sync` for sendable shared iterators". crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/store/cache.rs (art:read-cache) compiles unchanged: it iterates only within one call, and its Vec<u8> keys and CacheEntry values are already Send + Sync. The cache is in memory only, so no store, export or older seat sees a difference. tantivy 0.27 still depends on lru 0.18.5, so the lock keeps both versions.
